name: Vision Enhancement Kit

ad.headline: Improve Vision
ad.description: The new and improved Vision Glass Treatment forms a chemical bond with your windshield, creating a hydrophobic surface that repels water. Its anti-static ceramic polymers adhere to clean, dry glass - making it ideal for windshields and other exterior glass surfaces. Vision Glass Treatment remains highly effective even after months of everyday driving, standing up to harsh conditions like heavy rain, snow, car washes, glass cleaners, and salt spray.
benefits: Great for EV / HEV front, side, and backup cameras.
Enables easier clearing of ice, snow, and dirt.
Reduces glare of oncoming vehicle lights.
Allows for easy removal of bugs and bird droppings.
